commit_message:
docs: record wave-2 decisions; tell users about human-check pages in the cover

decisions.md gets a wave-2 section: why Sci-Hub human checks are reported rather than solved, why the member key goes only to verified hosts, why only the losing Anna's request is cancelled, and why the installer's end-to-end test stays. The README cover now says a human-check page is reported, not returned as the book, as the AGENTS.md rule asks for user-visible changes.
